question: What has been told to the addressee concerning the group of Ṣaṭmukha and others in this account?
premises: Something is said to have been told.
The recipient is addressed as Kāmeśī.
Reference is made to the group of Ṣaṭmukha and to another item joined by a particle.
inference: What concerns the group of Ṣaṭmukha and the associated group has been told to Kāmeśī.
uncertainties: The full content of what was told is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: O Kāmeśī, it has been told to you concerning the group of Ṣaṭmukha and also concerning that group.
